_comment: WP-1509 PROPOSAL (numbers measured on device and desktop captures later). Ring radii per tier in metres, measured to the cell square (TDD 'Cell streaming as built': near 128/192/256, far 384/512/640 on Low/Medium/High, 32/64 m unload hysteresis). Floor and Low are UNCHANGED from the TDD Low column (a pin test holds them). Desktop is a launch platform (agent 2026-11-22): High is the desktop default tier (agent 2026-11-23), Ultra on request, so Ultra gets the longest rings and the full-resolution texture pack. Textures follow the Art Bible 'Texture maxima per tier': Floor and Low take the half-resolution variant (mip_offset 1, hero uniques 1024), Mid and High the full one (hero 2048), Ultra full plus the optional high-resolution pack (hero 4096). texture_budget_mb is the streamed-texture share of the foreground memory ceiling (AGENTS.md ceilings); Ultra numbers are ESTIMATES. near_cell_mb is the TDD 85 KB map cost plus an ESTIMATE for the cell's own textures.
